title: Kinetic Langevin Splitting Schemes for Constrained Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2603.23397v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Constrained sampling, the task of generating samples from a distribution restricted to a convex set, is an important problem in computational statistics. In this paper, we propose new unadjusted sampling algorithms obtained by applying the symmetric BAOAB and ABOBA splittings, of the kinetic Langevin dynamics, to a penalized surrogate of the constrained target. This also includes their stochastic gradient versions. Since the Hessian of the penalized surrogate is discontinuous across the boundary of the constraint set, analyses relying on a Lipschitz Hessian do not apply. We therefore develop an analysis based only on strong convexity and smoothness, proving one-step Wasserstein contraction schemes, non-asymptotic Wasserstein bounds of both schemes and complexity bounds. translated_title: 用于约束采样的动力学朗之万分裂格式
translated_abstract: 约束采样，即从限制在凸集上的分布中生成样本的任务，是计算统计学中的一个重要问题。在本文中，我们通过将动力学朗之万动力学的对称BAOAB和ABOBA分裂格式应用于约束目标分布的惩罚代理，提出了新的未校正采样算法，其中包括它们的随机梯度版本。由于惩罚代理的Hessian矩阵在约束集边界处不连续，依赖于Lipschitz Hessian的分析不再适用。因此，我们开发了一种仅基于强凸性和光滑性的分析，证明了一步Wasserstein收缩性质、两种格式的非渐近Wasserstein误差界以及复杂度界。所得的随机梯度版本在复杂度上相比传统Euler型离散化方法有显著改进。数值实验验证了理论结果。
tldr: 本文提出将动力学朗之万动力学的BAOAB和ABOBA对称分裂格式应用于约束采样的惩罚代理目标，并在仅假设强凸性和光滑性（无需Lipschitz Hessian）的条件下建立了非渐近Wasserstein误差界，其随机梯度版本的复杂度显著优于传统Euler型离散化方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes new unadjusted constrained sampling algorithms based on symmetric BAOAB and ABOAB splittings of kinetic Langevin dynamics applied to a penalized surrogate, establishes non-asymptotic Wasserstein bounds under only strong convexity and smoothness assumptions (without requiring a Lipschitz Hessian), with stochastic gradient versions substantially improving complexity over traditional Euler-type discretizations.
